name: Sly 2: Band of Thieves
description: Sly 2: Band of Thieves running natively on your computer, made from the code on your own disc. Nothing from the game is in this application or in any download: the launcher reads your disc image and prepares the game on this machine.

alternates.reason: The European release has different code inside it. This version prepares only the North American disc; the European one is planned.
The Japanese release has different code inside it. This version prepares only the North American disc.
The Korean release has different code inside it. This version prepares only the North American disc.

disc.modified_reason: This disc image carries the right game but its code differs from the original disc. A modified or damaged image cannot be prepared; make a fresh image of your own disc.

unsupported.label: PlayStation Vita
unsupported.reason: The game's graphics processor work (the part of the PlayStation 2 that places every vertex on screen) is far heavier than the Vita can carry at full speed. There is no Vita version and none is planned.

unsupported.label: Other regions of the disc
unsupported.reason: Only the North American disc (SCUS-97316) is prepared by this version. European, Japanese and Korean discs are recognised and shown with a "Not supported yet" badge.

unsupported.label: Modified disc images
unsupported.reason: An image whose game code differs from the original disc is recognised as the game but cannot be prepared. Make a fresh image of your own disc.

game_folder.portable_note: Everything the game needs is in this one folder. Move or copy the folder and the game moves with it.

settings.note: Written to nativeee.ini in the game folder, the file the game reads; the game's own menu writes the same keys.

rows.label: Display mode
rows.help: A window you can resize, the whole screen, or a window without a frame that fills the screen.

rows.label: Aspect ratio
rows.help: Auto is the TV's 4:3; the wide shapes let the game draw a wider view.

rows.label: Graphics
rows.help: Auto picks the best one for this computer. Change it only if the picture is wrong.

rows.label: Frame rate
rows.help: The game always runs at its normal speed. 30 shows every other picture, 60 every picture; Off shows as many as the computer can draw.

rows.label: Vertical sync
rows.help: Waits for the display between pictures so none is torn.

locked_by.help: Off while the frame rate is not capped.

rows.label: Texture filter
rows.help: Original is what the game asked the console for.

rows.label: Frame counter
rows.help: The pictures shown per second, in the corner of the game window.

rows.label: Sound quality
rows.help: How the console's samples are smoothed. Standard is what the console does; Smooth is a little softer.

rows.label: Controller
rows.help: Auto uses the first controller plugged in and the keyboard when there is none.

rows.label: Keyboard and mouse
rows.help: The keyboard and mouse act as a controller when no controller is plugged in.

rows.label: Skip movies with a button
rows.help: Press Start during a movie to skip it.

rows.label: Resume a save state
rows.help: At once keeps the game window open; Restart closes and reopens the game first, which is slower but safer.
